root_cause.summary: Script #dx-analytics-dedupe của chính site ghi đè Node.prototype.insertBefore để chặn trùng lặp googletagmanager.com/gtm.js, nhưng bật cờ window.__dxGtmLoaded = true mà không thực sự chèn thẻ script — nên không bản snippet GTM nào chạy. / The site's own #dx-analytics-dedupe script overrides Node.prototype.insertBefore to de-duplicate googletagmanager.com/gtm.js, but sets window.__dxGtmLoaded = true without actually inserting the script tag — so none of the GTM snippets ever load.
fix: Xoá hẳn script #dx-analytics-dedupe / Delete the #dx-analytics-dedupe script
Xoá 2 trong 3 bản snippet GTM còn lại, giữ đúng 1 bản trong <head> kèm <noscript> / Remove 2 of the 3 remaining GTM snippets, keep exactly one in <head> with its <noscript>

en: GSC window 11 Jul→7 Aug (all 28 rows of the Days tab counted by hand for the exact total instead of the rounded '1.34K' tile; the hand-summed clicks total of 74 matches the Total clicks tile): clicks 72→74, impressions 1,288→1,337, queries-with-impressions 128→136. Reminder: GSC and GA4 are rolling 28-day windows. The delta against 7 Aug is the window shifting (3 new days in, 3 old days out), not any single day's traffic.

MEASUREMENT ALERT — GA4 IS STILL NOT FIXED, now day 12. Measured today: 27 Jul–2 Aug = 3 sessions, 3–9 Aug = 1 session. Checked directly on the live homepage: 0 GTM/gtag script tags loaded, window.gtag and window.google_tag_manager both undefined, dataLayer holds a single entry, no G- measurement ID. The #dx-analytics-dedupe script is STILL present and the __dxGtmLoaded flag is still true.

The only change since 7 Aug: the number of GTM snippet copies on the page dropped 4 → 3. This is NOT the fix — the root cause (the de-dupe script swallowing the tag) is untouched and GTM still does not load. #dx-analytics-dedupe must be deleted outright and 2 of the 3 remaining snippets removed.

CONSEQUENTLY: every 28-day GA4 figure in this snapshot (sessions 258, engaged 171, key events 21, users 131, total events 1,740) is an under-count. Comparing it with 7 Aug (287/194/23) is meaningless as a business signal — both are under-counts and differ only in how much pre-29-Jul data the window still holds.
AI assistant channel: still 1 session from chatgpt.com / ai-assistant (0.39% of total), 100% engagement, 15 seconds, 7 events, 0 key events — also inside the window affected by the tracking fault.

Ahrefs jumped: referring domains 366→395 (all-time 381→410), backlinks 372→401 (all-time 397→426) — the largest three-day gain since tracking began. Quality caveat: only 3 of 395 referring domains are followed (0.8%). DR still 0, organic keywords/traffic still 0. Health Score held at 100 (crawl at 04:05 today, 17 URLs, 0 errors).

AI citations slipped: 19 → 18 (ChatGPT 11→10 across 3 pages, Copilot flat at 8 across 2). AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini and Perplexity remain 0; Grok is paused by Ahrefs so it is recorded as null, not 0.

AI Visibility holds at 26/100. All 5 measurable dimensions are unchanged: Presence 2/10, Citation surface 1/10, Technical readiness 9/10 (6 of 7 signals, only llms.txt missing), Measurement 1/10. Third-party corpus stays at 0/10 but was NOT re-tested today and is flagged as such.

All 7 technical signals were re-measured today directly on the dxliving.com origin: robots.txt names no AI bot (pass), sitemap.xml carries 76 URLs — up from 75 (pass), /faq serves FAQPage and returns 200 in ~1.0s (pass), /articles returns 200 in ~2.0s with Article + BreadcrumbList (pass), the homepage carries Organization + LocalBusiness JSON-LD (2 passes), /llms.txt still 404 (fail).

No backfill for 8 and 9 Aug: the GSC/GA4 windows could be rebuilt with custom date ranges, but Ahrefs (referring domains, backlinks, AI citations, health score, Brand Radar) cannot be rewound to a past date — so today alone was added rather than inventing figures for those days.
